title: Modular A/V: Audio mixer
description: A mixer for your voice: which effects run, in which order, and how loud. Holds no effects itself: it mixes the effect modules a world has turned on. A GM can lay a preset over the whole table, or one player.

recommends.reason: Opens the mixer from the voice panel and the settings window.

facts.label: Who uses it
facts.value: Each player for their own voice; a GM for the whole table's
